experiments.notes: v12 replaces periodic Anti-AFK heartbeats with reactive AFK recovery. The UI-thread timer polls UnitIsAFK('player') every 2s and performs no activity while the player is not AFK. On actual AFK it waits for native cast/channel to clear, executes DoEmote('STAND'), waits 500ms, then only if AFK persists casts Demon Armor when known or sends '.' to SAY as fallback. It verifies the AFK flag after 1s and retries after 3s while AFK remains. Diagnostics add current AFK detected state and successful recovery count. Sources: MikeBeloborodov/VanillaWowApi for 1.12.1 UnitIsAFK/PLAYER_FLAGS_CHANGED; Warcraft Wiki SitStandOrDescendStart history for pre-2.1 DoEmote('STAND') / SitOrStand behavior.

LOW SPEC keeps its 800x600 graphics preset but preserves base audio and omits -nosound when BG SOUND is selected. External 5875 evidence: brndd/vanilla-tweaks sound-in-background patch and OctoLauncher patch table. Per-launch AUTO POSTAĆ 1 toggle in MULTIBOX. Updater passes WOW112_AUTOCHAR_FIRST=1 only to selected child processes. AutoLoginBridge waits for successful native login, then on the WoW window thread executes guarded GlueXML: CharacterSelect_SelectCharacter(1,1) followed by CharacterSelect_EnterWorld(). No SendInput/focus. 60s fail-safe window; one-shot Lua flag prevents repeated EnterWorld. Exact project evidence: current PARALLEL uses FrameScript_Execute 0x00704CD0 and object-manager 0x00B41414; external Vanilla GlueXML confirms first list slot is index 1. LOW reliability follow-up: readiness now keys off CharacterSelectUI (the actual GlueXML screen), not the CharacterSelect model frame. Selection and EnterWorld are split into two UI-thread polls; EnterWorld waits until CharacterSelect.selectedIndex==1 after UPDATE_SELECTED_CHARACTER. Poll window increased from 60s to 120s for slow LOW launches.
